rules.statement: The transferor is duty bound to adduce evidence to show that he did not intend to dispose of the beneficial interest of the property.
rules.supporting_quote: Sec. 83 of the Trusts Ordinance specifically states that where the owner of the property transfers or bequeaths it, and it cannot reasonably be inferred consistently with the attendant circumstances that he intended to dispose of the beneficial interest therein, the transferee or legatee must hold such benefit for the owner or his legal representative.
